The contract became subject to disclosure after a first amendment signed 10-07-2026 that changed the development schedule and amount (an increase over the original contract of 12-26-2025 for KRW 5,807,400,000). Term 12-26-2025 to 07-31-2027, the end date reflecting expected payment on completion of development and verification and subject to change; no advance payment, payment within 30 days of meeting payment conditions; in-house and outsourced production.
